todo: - [editorial] Scene 47: narration calls {a} 'my senior' (S186), 'my senpai' (S184), 'Senpai' (S187/S188); direct address '{a}.' vs '{a}-senpai' (47:f31c). Pick one style.

rows.en:
Hello, everyone, nice to meet you.
My name is Mayumi Taguchi.
I'm a first-year who just started at this school.
I think I'm totally normal, but everyone says I'm a weird girl.
How rude.
There's nothing weird about me at all.
Most of all, they say it's weird that I'm in the newspaper club.
Whatever club I join, that's my business, right?
According to everyone, I'm just not the newspaper-club type.
So what kind of person IS the newspaper-club type, I'd like to know?
Anyway, see, today I've been called in by my senpai.
It's {a}.
Full name... um, {b} {a}.
He's a third-year.
Apparently he's got something really, really important to talk to me about.{p}Me, I think {a} is...
A really cool person
A nasty person
A weird person
A fun person
A mysterious person
Actually... I love him

But that's okay.
Because I think he's cool.{p}

And that same {a} called me in!
Apparently it's going to be just the two of us, too.
It makes my heart pound.
...But I've got cram school today.{p}

...What should I do?
Should I just skip cram school?
Go to cram school
Skip cram school

If he asks me out... what'll I do? Hehe.
Actually, it's almost time to meet.
We're meeting in the club room.
I guess I'll head over now.{p}

...But you know, this school is kind of gloomy.
It has this weird atmosphere.
Well, it's a big school.
When a school's this big, maybe it's different from normal schools?
But see, I only found out after I got in: there are a lot of accidents at this school.
And I don't mean ordinary accidents.
Supernatural stuff... It's so scary!
All kinds of horrible things happen here that defy common sense.{p}

...Oh, here I am.
I wonder if {a} is here already.{p}
"Excuuuuse meee!"{p}

Oh, {a} is already here.
Just as I'd expect.
"Hey, Taguchi.
Sorry for making you come all the way here.
Well, have a seat."
"...Oh, yes.
Excuse me."
I sat down all right, but my heart is pounding.
What on earth is this talk going to be about?
{a} is looking at me and smiling.{p}

Maybe he likes me.
Tee-hee...{p}

"So, you know the second gym is almost finished, right?"
Of course I know that much.
The kids on the sports teams are really looking forward to it.
There are even people who came to this school just for that.
"...See, the thing is.
To mark the occasion, I want to do a feature on the school's seven wonders."{p}

My junior high had them too.
At my junior high, there was the piano where only the F key won't play, and the dancing skeleton in the science room.
Then there was the puddle that never dries up, and Hanako-san of the restroom.
Um, what else was there?
Umm...
"So, Taguchi.
Do you know what used to be there before the second gym was built?"{p}...Hmm, I've heard about that.
If I remember right, what used to be there was...
The cherry tree
The old school building
The flower bed

"It was the old school building, wasn't it?"
"That's right.
They tore down the old school building exactly two years ago, in the summer.{p}Do you know the story of what happened back then?"
I know it
I don't know it

"I don't know that story."
"Then I'll tell it to you."
With that, {a} gave a little cough.
Then, slowly, he began to speak.{p}

...This school has a lot of scary stories.
I think you've heard some of them yourself.{p}

Of course, there were plenty of stories about the old school building too.
For example, there was the full-length mirror on the stair landing of the old building: if you set up facing mirrors there at 3:33 and 33 seconds in the middle of the night, something happens.
Or, if you count the steps on Friday the 13th, a staircase that should have fourteen steps has only thirteen.
And of course, there were rumors about Hanako-san.
The rumor was that Hanako-san lived in the girls' restroom on the third floor of the old school building.{p}

I was never good with scary stories.
I wasn't really fond of them.
But now I'm a complete occult fanatic.
What on earth changed me?
I'll tell you that story now.{p}You want to hear it, don't you?
I want to hear it
It sounds scary, so no thanks

Good.
That's what makes calling you here worth it.{p}

After all, you're going to have to put together a feature on the school's seven wonders.
Two years ago, we did a seven wonders feature too.
Or, to be precise, we tried to, I suppose.
The club president back then told me to, so I drew up the plan, but for various reasons the project was called off.
When they tore down the old school building, a huge number of skeletons turned up.
Human ones, of course.
There used to be all kinds of rumors: that there was once an air-raid shelter under the old building, or that lots of war dead lay buried around there.
Apparently they were true.
Because of that, a lot of accidents happened.
They had to hold some pretty large-scale purification rites.
Around that same time, I was planning that feature.
I had my senior back then, someone named Hino, gather people who knew a lot about the school's seven wonders.{p}
Listening to story after story, I learned plenty of scary stories about this school myself.{p}

But in the end, that project turned into 'The Mystery of the Masses of Skeletons Found Under the Old School Building!'
Well, it couldn't be helped.
Something that really happened has more impact than mere rumors, after all.
You probably remember it too, don't you?
The police came, and it was even in the newspapers.
I was the one who wrote the school paper's article on it back then.
It was really well received.{p}

But I was disappointed.
Because that project got scrapped.
Even though it wasn't my project to begin with.
It was the club president's idea.
Still, for some reason, I was really disappointed.
Funny thing.
When that project was pushed onto me, I felt really bad about it.
If I could have, I wouldn't have done it.
That's how much I hated scary stories.
And yet look at me now.
I'm dying to do it, of my own free will.
So I thought about it.
When the second gym went up on the site of the old school building, this time I'd finally make this project happen.{p}

So, what do you say?
I'd like to entrust you with that important role.{p}How about it?
Will you do it?
I'll do it
No, thank you
Why don't you do it yourself, senpai?
returns: 47:28b4: RETURN - direct address 'senpai' is lower-case here; S188 capitalizes 'Senpai' as a term of address; editorial to unify.

rows.en:
I understood the idea.
But I found it strange.
If {a} wants to do this project that badly, why doesn't he do it himself?
So I worked up the nerve to ask.
"Um, you've been saving this project for so long, so why don't you do it yourself?"
And he smiled, delighted, as if he'd expected my question all along.
It was kind of scary.
"...Well, you see, I already know too many scary stories.
Honestly, seven wonders just can't hold them anymore.
You don't know that many yet, do you?
That's why you're the right person for it.
You'll do it, won't you?"
What should I do?
...If he knows so many scary stories, he'd only have to pick seven of them. So why can't he do it?
Something feels off.
But as a project, it does sound interesting.{p}What should I do?
Should I give it a try?
I'll give it a try
I won't do it

"I'll give it a try."
The answer just slipped out of me.
{a} looked really happy.
But there's a problem.
I like scary stories, but I don't know a thing about this school's seven wonders.
"...Then I'll round up seven people who know a lot about the school's seven wonders.
...Let's see.
The day after tomorrow would be good.
Could you come to the club room again the day after tomorrow?
I'll have it all settled with the seven of them by then."
Wow, so well prepared.
Had {a} been planning this from the start, sure I'd take it on?{p}

In the end, that was all the talk was about.
Nothing else I'd been hoping for happened... oh well.{p}

...And then, two days later.
Today is the day we agreed on.{p}What should I do?
Should I go to the newspaper club?
Go
Don't go

This summer, the long construction work ends, and the second gym will be completed where the old school building used to stand.
To go with that, it was decided we'd run a horror feature.
My senpai saw promise in me, and I, just a new first-year, ended up chosen to be in charge of it.
But I don't really know what kinds of scary stories have been passed down at this school.
So he arranged to gather people who know stories about the school's seven wonders in the club room.
Apparently he has something else to do and can't come, so I'm the one who actually has to run things.
I won't know who the seven people are until I meet them, so I'm a little nervous.
The seven are supposed to gather in the club room after school today.
I like scary stories quite a lot, but if anything, I might be kind of a scaredy-cat.{p}
Even so, my feet carried me toward the club room on their own, against my will; maybe that was because, somewhere in my heart, I had a morbid curiosity to see something frightening.{p}

Once the six had made sure who I was, they lowered their faces again, as if fixing their eyes on a single spot on the table.
I didn't recognize a single face.
The school's so big, it's no surprise if there are faces I've never seen, even in my own year.
From the atmosphere, the six gathered here seemed to be strangers to one another, too.
Six?
Didn't my senpai say seven people would be asked to come?
So that means one of them hasn't arrived yet?
For now, I sat down in an empty seat.{p}

No one spoke, and an awfully awkward silence dragged on.
I was the one who should have spoken, but the mood made it really hard.
Everyone kept looking down, not moving a muscle.
And there was still no sign of the seventh person who was supposed to come.
Time just went by, wasted.
Sitting like this forever wasn't going to get us anywhere.
"...Um, everyone, I know you're all busy and took the time to come, so I'd like to get started soon."
I worked up the nerve to speak.
"I heard seven people would be gathering. Are you the seventh?
Or are you the newspaper club person who's going to listen to our stories?"
One of them muttered it with his head still bowed, only his eyes turned toward me.
What a gloomy-looking person.
Just having him look at me sent a chill down my spine.
"Yes.
I'm Mayumi Taguchi from the newspaper club.
My senpai, {a}, told me to hear your stories today.
It's nice to meet you all."
When I answered, they all broke into creepy smiles.
And after that, nobody said a word to me.
What is with these people?
It's like they aren't even alive.
"...Um, how about it?
There's no point waiting like this, so shall we get started?"
My patience ran out, and I asked again.
"Fine by me."
One of them said it, and the rest slowly nodded.
What kind of scary stories were they going to tell me?
Was I the only one who felt the club room air was strangely heavy, pressing down on my shoulders?
A lukewarm draft leaking through the ill-fitting window licked at my cheek.
I couldn't shake the feeling that something nameless and sinister was here, waiting for something to happen.
There was something here that filled me with an unspeakable dread.
Why?
Why would I think such a thing?
Even breathing felt hard.
I had never felt like this before.
As if to cut those thoughts off, I spoke in a loud voice.
"Well then, let's begin."
Without waiting for the still-unseen seventh, the six who had been gathered began their scary stories from school.{p}

Hmm.
I'll go to cram school after all.
He's wonderful, but studying matters too.
I'll ask him to make the talk tomorrow instead.
Tomorrow after school...
Then I'm free till any hour!{p}

Hee.
But I wonder what the talk is about.
If he tells me, 'Go out with me'...
What'll I do?
Tee-hee.{p}

"Taguchi, what are you grinning about?"
Oh, it's Sanae☆
...There's a rumor she's going out with {a}.
I wonder if it's true.
If it is, I'd hate that.{p}What should I do?
I can't forgive this.
Grill her about it
Burst into tears and run away
Try dancing, for starters

"Sanae, is it true you're going out with {a}?"
"..."
Sanae isn't saying anything.
Maybe it's hard for her to answer?
Right, time to grill her.
"Well, are you? Please answer me!"{p}

"...Well, you see, go ask the grandma in my mouth."
"Huh...?"{p}

"Eeeeeek!☆"
W-What on earth is Sanae?{p}

What do I do?
If {a} is going out with someone like her...
He's sure to get eaten!☆
"{a}!!!☆"
Huff, huff.
...Forget it, I can't go to cram school now!☆{p}
"...Oh, Taguchi. What is it? Why the big rush?"{p}"{a}..."
Is it true you're going out with Sanae?
Do you know what's inside Sanae's mouth?
Do you like me?
Why did Kazama and Arai have a fight?
"Is it true that you're going out with Sanae?"{p}"Huh...? What's gotten into you all of a sudden?"
I... I really like you!☆
I... I'm worried about you!☆

"I... I really like you!☆"
"Huh...?"{p}

Eeek, I said it!☆
Oh gosh, this is so embarrassing!
I can't even look him in the face.
...But I wonder what kind of face he's making.
Maybe he's turned even redder than me.{p}

...Uh, he's smiling.
It's kind of a weird smile...
"Taguchi, do you mean that?"
...{a} has a look like he's plotting something.{p}How should I answer?
It's true
That was a total lie

"I-It's true.
It was love at first sight with you, {a}."
"Well now, that's nice to hear.
I think love at first sight means it's fate.
Besides, to tell the truth, I've had my eye on you too, Taguchi, ever since you joined the club.
So, shall we start going out, as of today?"{p}

He looks really happy.
I'm so glad I confessed.
Going on dates all over the place, eating lunch together, secretly swapping letters...
I've dreamed of it for sooooo long.
And then... oh, right, late-night love calls.
Is that a bit old-fashioned?
But it was my dream, to talk on the phone with my sweetheart for as long as I like, without anyone getting in the way.
The phone has a different charm from actually meeting and talking, you know.
I was promised a phone of my very own, so I studied like crazy to get into this school.
And now that dream is coming true so soon...
"But going out at this school is really tough, you know.
Unless we steer clear of all sorts of obstacles, we could lose our lives."{p}

He has a serious look on his face.
Does this school ban dating or something?
There are plenty of couples everyone knows about, though.
"Let's see, to name a few of the things that are off-limits...
First, you'd better avoid dates under the cherry trees.
And sharing an umbrella is a little dangerous, too.
And then..."
"There's more?"
"That's right.
There are lots more besides these, but...
Oh, I know, the phone!"
"Don't tell me phones are off-limits too...?"{p}

No way, I don't want that.
I've dreamed of it for so long...!
"Hmm, the phone is the most dangerous of all.
Especially the pay phone beside the school's back gate. You must never, ever use it.
This isn't just for couples, but that phone is the devil's phone."{p}
The devil's phone, he says?!★
That's scary
Please stop making a fool of me

"I-Is that really true?
I'm so scared I'm shaking..."{p}

I heard about it from a friend once.
There was a case where a student from this school was murdered in a phone booth.
A schoolgirl was found dead under strange circumstances, or something.
It seems the killer was never caught, but maybe that phone booth is the devil's phone...
He's watching me with a sly grin.
Did he always smile like that?
"It's okay, I'll protect you.
I know!
I'll let you have a charm with truly miraculous powers.
It'd be terrible if anything happened to you, my precious sweetheart."
With that, {a} took something out of his pocket.{p}

It was an eraser, the kind they sell everywhere for about fifty yen.
"...Um."
"Let's see. Normally it's a luxury item you couldn't get even for ten thousand yen, but you're my cute little sweet honey.
So, as a special deal, a thousand yen will do."
Ugh, he might be kind of a nutcase...
That's when it happened!{p}

"Hey, Kazama, cut it out!"
He started blurting out things that made no sense.
"What's the big deal over a little thing like this..."
"That's right, we're giving you our blessing."
One voice after another came out of his mouth.
Eww, it's like he really is a nutcase.
"{a}, don't think you can get one over on us."
"How cruel of you, {a}. Weren't you into older women?"{p}

Oh, I feel like I'm going to lose my mind.
I got unsteadily to my feet and walked to the door.
"Taguchi!"
"I'm really sorry, Senpai, I'm just feeling kind of tired.
Please let me forget about today, okay?"{p}

"Man, how pathetic.
Dumped again."
"Don't let it bother you.
You've got me, your best friend, right here with you."
"That's right, and you've got me, {a}, the older woman you like so much."
"Oh, come on, none of us has aged a day since two years ago."
"Oh my, I wouldn't mind being in the same year at all."
"Well, I wonder about that.
{a} seems to be growing up just fine, so perhaps we're getting older too."
Hmm, I really am hearing all kinds of voices.
"Come on, everyone, please be a little quieter!
Thanks to all of you, everyone treats me like a total weirdo!"
Oh, that one's {a}'s voice.
"Ha ha ha, oh please. If you fuss over little things like that, you'll never become a fine person like me."
"That's right.
It's because of that seven wonders meeting that we ended up like this, you know."
"Isn't it nice, though? We never get lonely."
"Who knew Mr. Shirai's experiment would have a side effect like this?"
{a} and the others are living in a world beyond my imagination.
I can't keep up, so I'll put him out of my mind for good.{p}Okay, when I get home, I've got to write up my notice to quit the club.{p}

"Waaaaah!☆"
All I can do is cry and run away.
I'm sooo sad.
Waaah.
...I want to see {a}.
Who cares about cram school anymore!{p}

"Senpai!
{a}!!☆"
"Oh, Taguch-- What's wrong?
Why are you crying?"
"{a}..."
{a} is all flustered.
Oh, he took out a handkerchief for me.
But it's dirty.
...What a hopeless guy.
"Taguchi, are you okay?"{p}

"...Oh, yes."
Maybe I was a bother, suddenly running to him in tears like that.
"I don't know why you're crying, but I'm glad you came.
There's something important I want to talk about today.
I'd really like you to hear it..."
...What could it be?{p}

Guess I'll try dancing for now.
I may not look it, but I'm kind of confident about my dancing.
I even got praised for my dance routine back in kindergarten.
Let's see, summer's almost here, so it's got to be that one, right?{p}

"Haaaaaah! Drink up, sing out, dance away, and raise a ruckus!"
It's the Bon dance I dance at the festival every year.
I've even got the festival music down pat.
And my footwork's practically at master level, right?{p}

I know, since I'm at it, I'll just dance all the way to the club room.
I wonder if he'll be surprised.
"You're a great dancer.
I really like people who dance well."
What if he says something like that to me?{p}

Oh, while I was going on like that, I reached the club room.
"{a}, it's Taguchiii!"{p}

Still dancing, I opened the door and went in.
At first he seemed startled, but he quickly turned serious and stared intently at my dancing.
Then he slowly got up from his chair and clapped loudly.
It was a standing ova..........something, the highest kind of applause.
"That was a splendid dance.
That must be what they call the 'Bon Dance' performed in this region.
Watching it, I felt as if my heart were cleansed.
Just as I thought, your talent is the real thing.
Seeing that dance just now has convinced me."{p}

As he said this, he took something like a ballpoint pen out of his uniform pocket.
"The truth is, I'm not from this planet.
I've been dispatched to Earth on a certain mission from the far-off planet Pohipohi."
Oh, what an imagination he has.
I've never heard of a planet with a name like that, but it's funny how it starts to sound real coming from him.
"I heard there was a genius dancer on Earth named Mayumi Taguchi, and I was dying to meet you.
Well, well, your dance was even more moving than I imagined.
Now that I've confirmed that, one of my missions is complete.
I'll move straight on to the next one."{p}

When he held the pen-like thing up high, it flashed for an instant.
"Eek!☆
Hey!☆"
Before I knew it, I was inside a glass pod.
It seems to be made of some special material...
No matter how I pound and kick it, it won't break.
He laughed and said,
"On our rival planet, a planet called Sunbararia, there's a troupe of dancers famous across the universe called the Sunbararia Dancers.
So now our planet Pohipohi is forming a rival dance troupe of its own: the Pohipohi Dance Angels.
My new mission is to scout you and take you back to planet Pohipohi.
And of course, I'll be carrying it out."{p}

Wait a minute.
Don't go deciding that on your own!☆
He spoke into the fake ballpoint pen.
"This is the Earth dispatch unit. Transporting the rumored genius dancer to planet Pohipohi.
Request enrollment procedures for the Pohipohi Dance Angels."{p}
And then,
"Transport!☆"{p}

...I know, but still.
Our school is always trying to add all kinds of facilities.
And every time, there are accidents and stuff.
People getting hurt, ghosts showing up, it's a whole mess.
"The thing is, to mark the gym's construction, I want to do a special feature on the school's seven wonders."
Seven wonders...?{p}

"Where they're building the second gym, there used to be the old school building.
All sorts of supernatural phenomena happened there.
They tore it down two summers ago.
And then something incredible happened.{p}
...You'll listen, won't you?"

"Do you like me?"
"...Huh? Wh-What are you saying all of a sudden?"
{a} is all flustered.
...So cuuute!{p}

"Why did Kazama and Arai have a fight?"
..........
Oh, he's trying not to laugh.
"...Where did you hear about that?"
Um...
Why did I even say that?
I just said something that suddenly popped into my head.
...It's scary.
It's like someone's pulling my strings.
"But, Taguchi.
Did you come running all out of breath just to say that?"
...Ugh.
What am I doing?
...Actually, I rushed over here because of Sanae.{p}
Um, what I wanted to say was...
Is it true you're going out with Sanae?
Do you know what's inside Sanae's mouth?
Do you like me?

"I... I'm worried about you!☆
Don't you think Sanae's a little strange?
Do you know?
About her mouth..."{p}

"That was a total lie."
"..."
He's sulking.
Puffed up just like a blowfish.
"...Don't tease me so much."
Ha ha, a lecture?
"Well, whatever. That's enough idle chatter.
Taguchi, you know the second gym is going to be finished soon, right?"{p}

"Was it the cherry tree?"
"...No.
If they cut down the big cherry tree around there, sure, they could use a lot more land.
But that tree can't be cut down.
Whenever anyone tries to lay a hand on it, accidents happen.
People have even died.
That tree is no ordinary cherry tree."
...Huh, really?
"Taguchi, what used to stand on the second gym's site was the old school building.
I'll tell you a story from back then.
...But before that,
let me tell you a little about that cherry tree.
There's a legend that if two people kiss under that tree without anyone seeing, they'll be bound together forever.{p}What do you say?
Shall we try kissing there sometime?"
...Wh-Whaaat?!
I'd love to
Quit making a fool of me

"I-I'd love to."
"Huh? Really?"
{a} turned red.
"Taguchi, you shouldn't say things like that so lightly.
Oh, were you maybe just joking?
If so, that's fine.
Just between us, the people who acted out that tree's legend never came to any good.
So don't you go copying them, Taguchi.
I just wanted to tell you that.
Anyway, about the old school building..."
What a stiff.
I really would've been fine with it.
...Just kidding.
"Taguchi, are you listening?"
Oops, my bad.
"Y-Yes. I'm listening."
I've got to listen properly.
It's {a}'s story, after all.
Hee hee.
...Taguchi, why are you smiling like that?
This isn't a story you can listen to with a smile.{p}

Long ago, all sorts of supernatural phenomena happened in the old school building.
Lots of people had terrifying experiences there.
Then, two summers ago, that old school building was torn down.
Now I'll tell you the story of what happened then.{p}
You want to hear it, don't you?

"The flower bed's still there, isn't it?
Every year the hydrangeas bloom so beautifully.
Bright red hydrangeas...
Did you know?
Those flowers bloom red by sucking up human blood."
Heh, that's such a common story.
Huh? Wait, wasn't it cherry trees that have corpses buried under them?
"You don't seem to take me seriously, but a lot of people really have died there.
Even members of the gardening club have died, you know."{p}

Even when he tells me that, it just doesn't click for me.
That flower bed isn't very big, and it's well tended but totally ordinary. It doesn't seem like a place with that kind of dark history at all.
"Hmm, I can tell from your face you don't believe me.
Forget it.
I was going to ask you to do a certain interview, but at this rate, there's no way it'd make a good article."
Whaaat★
If that's the case, you should've said so first!
Then I would've answered more seriously...
Is it too late now?
But just as I thought that, {a} was already packing up to go home.
"Sorry for making you come all this way today.
Well, good work."{p}

Yep, I was right.
The hydrangea season's almost over, but the red flowers are in full bloom.
The color of hydrangea flowers changes with the soil they grow in, you know.
Blue if it's alkaline, and if it's acidic... red.
Saying they suck up human blood... As a story, that's way too common. Nobody could expect me to believe it.
Oh?
There's something under the flowers.
It looks like a red umbrella.
Did someone forget it? It still looks brand new.
I'll just touch it a little.
I pick up the umbrella ever so gently...
What a vivid red.
Oh, there's a name written on the handle.
Um... Yukari Tachibana...?
Is that how you read it?
I've never heard the name. Is it someone from the gardening club?{p}
(...Hateful.){p}

Wh-what?
Did I just hear a voice...?{p}
(...Hateful.){p}

S-see, I knew it!
But why... it's starting to sound more and more like my own voice.{p}
(...Hateful, ...hateful! ...Hateful☆){p}

I'm getting really irritated.
I won't stand for it anymore!
That person doesn't understand how I feel at all!
I hate them!
I hate them so much!{p}

(I want to kill them!)
Yes, I hate them so much I want to kill them!{p}

Just then!
